wiki.title: Cecilia Aguiar-Curry
wiki.extract: Cecilia Aguiar-Curry (born September 25, 1954) is an American politician serving as the majority leader of the California State Assembly since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, she has represented the 4th Assembly District since 2016.
